validation-failed.title: Missing or incorrect details
validation-failed.detail: The request could not be processed because some values are missing or are not in the expected form. Check the fields listed and try again.

social-provider-unavailable.title: Provider sign-in unavailable
social-provider-unavailable.detail: This way of signing in is not available right now. Use your email address and password, or try again later.

social-exchange-failed.title: Provider sign-in unsuccessful
social-exchange-failed.detail: Signing in with the chosen provider could not be completed. Start the sign-in again from the beginning.

social-identity-unknown.title: No account linked
social-identity-unknown.detail: The provider account is not linked to any account on the platform. You can create a new account.

social-email-in-use.title: Address already in use
social-email-in-use.detail: An account with this email address already exists. Sign in with the account's password.

last-administrator.title: Last administrator
last-administrator.detail: The organisation would be left with no administrator, so the change was not applied. Give another member the administrator role first, then try again.

seat-allowance-unavailable.title: Seats cannot be checked right now

registration.email_taken: An account already exists for this address, so a second one cannot be created. Sign in with that address instead, or ask for a password reset if you no longer remember it.
registration.password_policy: The password you chose does not meet the requirements, so the account was not created. Use between {minimum} and {maximum} characters, with at least one lowercase letter, one uppercase letter, one digit and one further character.

verification.token_invalid: This confirmation link is no longer valid, so the address has not been confirmed. Links last 24 hours and work only once — request a new one from the confirmation page.

sign_in.credential_invalid: The email address or the password is not right, so you have not been signed in. Check what you entered and try again, or ask for a password reset if you no longer remember it.
sign_in.account_locked: The account has been locked temporarily after too many unsuccessful attempts, so signing in is not possible for now. Use a password reset to unlock it right away.
sign_in.email_unverified: This email address has not been confirmed yet, so you cannot sign in for now. Open the link you received at registration, or request a new one from the confirmation page.

auth.rate_limited: There have been too many attempts for this address in a short time, so new ones are paused for now. Wait 15 minutes and try again.

session.invalid: The session is no longer valid, so the request was not processed. Sign in again to continue.
session.expired: The session expired after a period of inactivity, but your work in progress has been kept. Sign in again to continue exactly where you left off.
session.factor_invalid: The code is not valid, or the step has expired, so sign-in did not complete. Enter the code your app is showing now, or use one of your recovery codes.

password_reset.token_invalid: This reset link is no longer valid, so the password has not been changed. Links last 60 minutes and work only once — request a new one from the sign-in page.

membership.authentication_required: The request arrived without a valid session, so it was not processed. Sign in and try again.
membership.membership_required: Your account has access to no organisation, so this page cannot be shown. Create an organisation, or accept the invitation sent to your email address.
membership.insufficient_role: Your role in this organisation does not cover managing users, so the action was not carried out. Ask an administrator of the organisation to do it.
membership.member_not_found: That member no longer belongs to this organisation, so the change could not be applied. Refresh the list to see where things stand.
membership.last_administrator: This is the organisation’s only administrator, so taking away the role or the access would lock everyone out of its settings. Promote another member to administrator first, then repeat the action.

invitation.already_member: The person at this address already has access to the organisation, so no invitation was sent. Open the user list if you want to change their role.
invitation.already_pending: An invitation to this address is already outstanding, so a second one was not created. Send it again from the invitation list to issue a fresh link, or withdraw it if you want to invite the person at a different role.
invitation.not_found: That invitation is no longer outstanding — it was accepted or withdrawn — so the action was not carried out. Refresh the list to see where things stand.
invitation.address_mismatch: The invitation is for a different email address from the account you are signed in with, so it has not been used. Sign in with the address the invitation was sent to, or ask for one addressed to the account you use.

standing.expired: This invitation has run out of time, so the link no longer works and you have not been added to the organisation. Ask an administrator of the organisation to send it again — you will get a fresh link, good for another 7 days.
standing.consumed: This invitation has already been used, so the link no longer works. If you accepted it yourself, sign in; otherwise ask an administrator of the organisation for a new invitation.
standing.revoked: An administrator of the organisation withdrew this invitation, so you have not been added. If that was a mistake, ask them to invite you again.
standing.unknown: This link does not match any invitation, so you have not been added to an organisation. Check that you copied all of it from the email, or ask for a new invitation.

seats.allowance_reached: {limit, plural, =1 {The organisation’s only seat is taken} other {All # of the organisation’s seats are taken}}, so the invitation was not sent. A pending invitation holds a seat until it is accepted or withdrawn, even once its link has expired — withdraw an invitation or remove someone’s access, then send the invitation again.
seats.acceptance_refused: The organisation has no free seats left, so you have not been added, and your invitation is still valid. Ask an administrator of the organisation to free a seat, then open the link from the email again.
seats.unavailable: We could not check how many of the organisation’s seats are in use just now, so nothing was sent or changed. Try again in a few minutes.

totp.reauthentication_failed: The current password is not right, so the change was not made. Enter the password you sign in with now and try again.
totp.code_invalid: That code is not valid right now, so the step was not completed. Codes change every 30 seconds — open your authenticator app and enter the one shown now.
totp.code_shape: The code must be six digits, so it could not be checked. Enter the six digits your authenticator app is showing.
totp.already_enrolled: This account already has a second factor in force, so another cannot be added. Turn the current one off first if you want to use a different authenticator app.
totp.not_enrolled: This account has no second factor in force, so there is nothing to change. Turn it on from your account settings if you want that protection.

social.identity_taken: That provider account is already linked to an EasyESG account, so it cannot be linked again. Use a different account at the provider, or unlink it where it is linked now.
social.not_linked: This account has nothing linked at that provider, so there is nothing to unlink. Check the linked accounts listed in your settings.
social.last_credential: This is the only way you can sign in, so it cannot be removed — an account with no credential at all cannot be recovered and loses access to the organizations you belong to. Set a password first, then come back here.
social.email_in_use: An EasyESG account already exists for this address, so a second one cannot be created. Sign in with the account’s password, then link this provider account from your security settings — after that either one will sign you in.
social.exchange_failed: Signing in with the chosen provider could not be completed. Start the sign-in again from the beginning.
social.identity_unknown: The provider account is not linked to any account on the platform. You can create a new account.
social.provider_unavailable: This way of signing in is not available right now. Use your email address and password, or try again later.
social.email_unverified: The account’s address is not verified yet, so no session was created. Open the link in the verification email, or ask for it to be sent again.
social.redirect_rejected: The sign-in request did not start from an allowed address, so it was refused. Go back to the sign-in page and start again from there.

organization.country_not_supported: The platform does not operate in the country you chose yet, so the organization was not created. Choose one of the countries offered, or write to us if you need another one.
organization.legal_form_unknown: The legal form you gave is not among those registered for the organization’s country, so the change was not saved. Choose one of the forms offered in the list.
organization.not_found: The active organization could not be found, so its details were not shown. Refresh the page, and if it happens again choose another organization from the switcher.
organization.idno_malformed: The IDNO must be exactly thirteen digits and the value you entered is not, so the change was not saved. Check the number on the registration certificate and enter it again.
organization.lei_malformed: An LEI is twenty characters of upper-case letters and digits, and the value you entered is not, so the change was not saved. Copy it from the global register and try again.
organization.lei_check_digits: The LEI has the right shape but its check digits do not match the rest of the value, which usually means one character is wrong or two are swapped. The change was not saved. Compare it with the source you took it from.

entity.not_found: That entity does not exist in this organization, so it could not be shown. Refresh the list to see the entities that do.
entity.nace_code_unknown: One of the activity codes you entered is not in the classifier for the organization’s country, so the change was not saved. Choose the codes from the list offered.
entity.archived: The entity is archived, so its master data can no longer be changed. Its reports and exports remain available. Create a new entity if the activity continues in another form.
entity.consolidation_boundary_empty: You chose consolidated reporting but named no subsidiary inside the boundary, so the change was not saved. Add the subsidiaries included, or report on an individual basis.

period.not_found: That reporting period does not exist in this organization, so it could not be shown. Refresh the list to see the periods that do.
period.overlaps: Another reporting period for this entity already covers part of the dates chosen, and two periods cannot overlap. Adjust the start and end dates, or edit the period that already covers them.
period.dates_invalid: The dates given do not describe a period: the end falls before the start, or one of them is not a real calendar day. Check the days chosen and the timezone, then try again.
period.taxonomy_version_unavailable: No version of the standard is registered on the platform, so the period cannot be opened — every report has to be tied to a specific version. Contact support; this is resolved on our side.
period.locked: The period is locked, so it can no longer be changed by anyone, an administrator included. Reopen it with a stated reason to make the correction — the change stays visible as an amendment.
period.already_locked: The period is already locked, so it was not locked again. Refresh the page to see its current state.
period.not_locked: The period is not locked, so it cannot be reopened. Refresh the page to see its current state.

report.already_exists: This reporting period already has a report, and a period can hold only one. Open the report that already exists instead of creating another.
report.derived_disclosure_not_writable: This figure is calculated by the system from the values you enter, so it cannot be filled in directly. Change the values it is worked out from and the figure updates itself.
report.not_editable: The reporting period is locked, so the report can no longer be changed by anyone, an administrator included. Reopen the period with a stated reason to carry on — the change stays visible as an amendment.
report.not_found: That report does not exist in this organization, so it could not be shown. Refresh the list to see the reports that do.
report.taxonomy_version_unavailable: The version of the standard this report was created under is no longer available on the platform, so its questions cannot be shown. Your saved answers are not affected. Contact support; this is resolved on our side.
report.unknown_derivation_input: The value sent does not match anything the system calculates a figure from, so it could not be saved. Refresh the page and enter the value again.
report.unknown_disclosure_dimension: The category selected is not one the standard admits for this field, so the value could not be saved. Refresh the page and choose again from the list.
report.unknown_disclosure_element: The field submitted is not part of the version of the standard this report was created under, so it could not be saved. Refresh the page to load the current questions.

email_verification.subject: Confirm your email address
email_verification.body:
Hello,

Someone created an easyesg account with this email address. Open the link below to confirm the address and activate the account:

{verificationUrl}

The link is valid for 24 hours and works only once.

If you did not create the account, ignore this message: without confirmation the account cannot be used, and it is deleted automatically after 7 days.

password_reset.subject: Reset your password
password_reset.body:
Hello,

We received a request to reset the password for the easyesg account with this email address. Open the link below to choose a new password:

{resetUrl}

The link is valid for 60 minutes and works only once. After the password changes, every existing session is signed out and you will need to sign in again.

If you did not ask for a reset, ignore this message: your current password stays unchanged.

invitation.subject: You have been invited to {organizationName}
invitation.body:
Hello,

You have been invited to join {organizationName} on easyesg, the sustainability reporting platform. Open the link below to accept the invitation:

{invitationUrl}

The link is valid for 7 days, works only once, and works only for this email address.

If you were not expecting this invitation, ignore this message: no access is created unless you accept it.

admin_invitation.subject: Invitation to the easyesg administration console
admin_invitation.body:
Hello,

You have been invited to become an operator in the easyesg administration console. Open the link below to choose your password and set up your second sign-in factor:

{invitationUrl}

The link is valid for 24 hours and can be used once. The account is created only after you confirm the second factor.

If you were not expecting this invitation, ignore this message: without acceptance, no account is created.

admin.credential_invalid: The address or the password is not right, so no session was created. Check both and try again.
admin.account_locked: This account is locked after too many failed attempts, so signing in is not possible right now. Ask another platform administrator to unlock it.
admin.factor_invalid: That code is not valid right now, so sign-in did not complete. Open your authenticator app and enter the code it is showing now.
admin.session_expired: The administration session has expired, so the request was not processed. Sign in again to continue.
admin.session_invalid: The administration session is no longer valid, so the request was not processed. Sign in again to continue.
admin.insufficient_role: Your operator role does not include this part of the console, so the request was not processed. Ask a platform administrator to take the request.
admin.account_not_found: This operator account does not exist, so the request was not processed. Reload the list of accounts and try again.
admin.account_exists: An active or suspended operator account already holds this address, so no new one was created. Sign in with the existing account, or ask a platform administrator to remove it first.
admin.account_self: You cannot suspend or remove your own account, so the change was not made. Ask another platform administrator to make it if it is needed.
admin.last_platform_administrator: This is the only active platform administrator, and without it nobody could manage accounts, so the change was not made. Invite another platform administrator first.

account_change.suspend: This account is not active, so it could not be suspended. Reload the list to see its current state.
account_change.reactivate: This account is not suspended, so it could not be reactivated. Reload the list to see its current state.
account_change.remove: This account’s access has already been removed, so it can no longer be changed. To give this person access again, send a new invitation.

admin.account_not_locked: This account is not locked, so there was nothing to unlock. Reload the list to see its current state.
admin.invitation_not_found: This invitation is no longer pending — it was accepted or withdrawn — so it could not be changed. Reload the list of accounts.
admin.invitation_outstanding: This address already has a pending invitation, so another was not sent. Resend the existing invitation or withdraw it.

invitation_standing.expired: This invitation link has expired, so the account can no longer be created with it. Ask the platform administrator who invited you to resend the invitation.
invitation_standing.revoked: This invitation was withdrawn, so the account cannot be created with this link. If you still need access, ask a platform administrator for a new invitation.
invitation_standing.accepted: This invitation has already been used and the account exists. Sign in to the console with the address and password you chose.
invitation_standing.unknown: This link is no longer valid — it may have been replaced by a resent invitation — so the account cannot be created with it. Use the most recent invitation email, or ask for a new invitation.

admin.enrolment_missing: The second factor has not been set up, so there is no code to confirm. Go back to the authenticator step and try again.
